svg.title: Groundskeeper identity and role boundary
svg.desc: GitHub OAuth issues an eight-hour secure session after installation allowlist checks. Only session hashes are stored. Every request checks current membership and role. Viewers read reviews; reviewers and admins can save. Operators manage membership.
